name: Basic
description: PJRC Encoder's Basic example, unmodified, polling a KY-040 on D5/D6 (not interrupt pins): turned three detents clockwise the count runs to -12, four counts a detent and negative because A (CLK, the sketch's first pin) leads clockwise, which the library's state table counts down; turned back to the first detent it settles at -4. Every contact change chatters for its 1 ms, so the printed count steps back and forth (0, -1, 0, -1, -2...) before each transition settles, as a polled mechanical encoder does; the state machine keeps the net count right.
